text: The `docs` command runs the project's real doc build (read at WP start, not assumed), demonstrated once

state.evidence: it is NOT ex_doc; `docs/bin/publish` (mdagg + pandoc + typst) wired at `commands.docs.options.publish` in `d6b14d0` with argv pass-through and `in_all: false`. `bin/mg docs publish 20-concepts` produced the 132KB aggregate + 20MB PDF at v0.1.0, seal `20260810-1011.PUBLISH.errors` 0 bytes; called bare it exits 1 on the publisher's own usage line, seal `20260810-1010.PUBLISH.errors` 136 bytes
